name: get_apartment_listings
description: This tool is used to retrieve a list of available apartment listings based on user-specified criteria like location, number of bedrooms, apartment type, and price range.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: The area or city where the user is looking to find an apartment.

required_parameters.name: bedrooms
required_parameters.description: The number of bedrooms in the apartment. Can be specified as a numerical value (e.g., '2' for two bedrooms).

optional_parameters.name: apartment_type
optional_parameters.description: The type of apartment the user is interested in (e.g., 'penthouse', 'studio').

optional_parameters.name: max_price
optional_parameters.description: The maximum monthly rent the user is willing to pay for the apartment, specified in the local currency.

optional_parameters.name: min_price
optional_parameters.description: The minimum monthly rent the user is willing to pay for the apartment, specified in the local currency.

optional_parameters.name: pet
optional_parameters.description: Indicates whether the apartment must allow pets. Accepts two values: true (pet-friendly) or false (not pet-friendly).

optional_parameters.name: city
optional_parameters.description: The city where the user is looking to find an apartment.

result_parameters.name: apartment_id
result_parameters.description: A unique identifier for the specific apartment listing for which detailed information is being requested.

name: get_apartment_specific_info
description: This tool is used to retrieve detailed information about a specific apartment based on criteria such as location, number of rooms, price, size, and contact information for inquiries.

required_parameters.name: apartment_id
required_parameters.description: A unique identifier for the specific apartment listing for which detailed information is being requested.

optional_parameters.name: city
optional_parameters.description: The city where the user is looking for an apartment if required to retrieve the specific apartment listing.

optional_parameters.name: location
optional_parameters.description: The specific area or neighborhood of the city for the apartment, if needed for the detailed information request.

optional_parameters.name: bedrooms
optional_parameters.description: The number of bedrooms in the apartment, if this information is necessary to acquire the proper details.

result_parameters.name: price
result_parameters.description: The monthly rent price of the apartment.

result_parameters.name: size
result_parameters.description: The size of the apartment in square feet.

result_parameters.name: contact_number
result_parameters.description: The phone number for contacting the leasing company or landlord for the apartment.

result_parameters.name: pet
result_parameters.description: Indicates whether the apartment must allow pets. Accepts two values: true (pet-friendly) or false (not pet-friendly).

result_parameters.name: apartment_type
result_parameters.description: The type of apartment the user is interested in (e.g., 'penthouse', 'studio').

name: send_apartments_message
description: This tool is responsible for sending detailed information regarding user-selected apartments to the user's email address.

required_parameters.name: apartment_id
required_parameters.description: A unique identifier for the specific apartment listing for which detailed information is being requested.

optional_parameters.name: email
optional_parameters.description: The email address the user wants to send.
